title: Setting Optimal Reserve Prices using Fine-Tuned Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online auction houses must set reserve prices for highly differentiated products whose unstructured descriptions contain valuable demand information. Existing approaches generally require managers to specify product attributes in advance. We ask whether a language model can instead learn from listing descriptions and historical bids to set item-specific reserve prices before bidding begins. We fine-tune a pretrained text embedding language model using the structural likelihood of auction bids as its training objective. This directs representation learning toward the valuation distribution that determines the reserve decision. We show that consecutive upper bids identify the tail information needed to set an optimal reserve without observing or modeling the number of potential bidders. translated_title: 使用微调语言模型设定最优保留价
translated_abstract: 在线拍卖平台必须为高度差异化的产品设定保留价格，而这些产品的非结构化描述中蕴含着有价值的需求信息。现有方法通常要求管理者预先指定产品属性。我们探讨语言模型能否在竞拍开始之前，通过学习商品刊登描述和历史出价来为具体商品设定保留价格。我们以拍卖出价的结构似然函数作为训练目标，对预训练的文本嵌入语言模型进行微调，从而将表示学习引导至决定保留价决策的估值分布上。我们证明，连续的最高出价能够识别设定最优保留价所需的尾部信息，而无需观察或建模潜在竞拍者的数量。一种分样本估计器在一半数据上学习表示，并在该表示的条件下进行结构估计与推断。
tldr: 该论文以拍卖出价的结构似然函数为训练目标微调预训练语言模型，从非结构化商品描述中学习估值分布表示，从而在无需预先指定产品属性或建模潜在竞拍者数量的情况下，为差异化商品设定最优保留价格。
en_tdlr: This paper fine-tunes a pretrained language model using the structural likelihood of auction bids as its training objective, learning valuation representations from unstructured listing descriptions to set optimal item-specific reserve prices without pre-specified product attributes or modeling the number of potential bidders.
